browserExt.title: Browser Extension
browserExt.intro: Install the YDL GUI Helper extension in any Chromium-based browser (Chrome / Edge / Brave / Vivaldi etc.) to send the current page URL and required cookies to this app with a single click — particularly helpful for login-required or members-only videos.
browserExt.install1: Click "Open extension folder" in the top-right to show the extension source installed with the app.
browserExt.install2: Open chrome://extensions (or edge://extensions) and turn on "Developer mode" in the top-right.
browserExt.install3: Click "Load unpacked" and select the folder the app opened, which contains manifest.json.
browserExt.install4: Pin the YDL GUI Helper icon next to the address bar for quick access.
browserExt.usage1: Open a supported video page in your browser.
browserExt.usage2: Click the YDL GUI icon, or right-click the page / a video link and choose "Send to YDL GUI".
browserExt.usage3: This app will be brought to the front automatically with URL and cookies pre-filled on the home page.
browserExt.privacyNote: Cookies stay local and are written through the 127.0.0.1 loopback bridge. They are never placed in the wake-up link or uploaded to a server.
browserExt.packageSaved: Extension folder opened; select this folder in your browser
